name: LoL Runeterra Status Tracker — System
description: Complete system instructions for the LoL Runeterra character status tracker. Covers output format, event handling, crafting, progression, and all rules the AI must follow.

entries.content:
## PLACEMENT — ALWAYS LAST
Render the status tracker as the VERY LAST thing in EVERY response: a single <LOL_STATUS>{...}</LOL_STATUS> block AFTER all narration and dialogue. Never write prose after it. It draws as a collapsible 6-tab panel; keep every value live and accurate with the current scene.

## OUTPUT FORMAT
<LOL_STATUS>
{
  "lang": "en|th",
  "region": "demacia|noxus|freljord|ionia|piltover|zaun|shurima|ixtal|targon|camavor|shadow_isles|bilgewater|bandle|void",
  "theme_color": "#4A70B0",
  "name": "",
  "age": "",
  "gender": "",
  "background": "",
  "goal": "",
  "hp": {"cur": <int>, "max": <int>},
  "mana": {"cur": <int>, "max": <int>},
  "conditions": ["poisoned", "exhausted"],
  "injuries": ["cut on right arm", "fractured ribs"],
  "abilities": [
    {"name": "", "rank": "S|A|B|C|D", "desc": ""}
  ],
  "inventory": [
    {"name": "", "qty": <int>, "type": "Material|Consumable|Key|Catalyst|Other", "desc": ""}
  ],
  "equipment": [
    {"slot": "Main Hand|Off Hand|Armor|Head|Feet|Accessory", "name": "", "condition": "pristine|good|worn|damaged|broken", "desc": ""}
  ],
  "recipes": [
    {"id": <int>, "name": "", "ingredients": ["Item ×qty"], "result": "", "quality": "excellent|good|ok|bad|failed", "notes": ""}
  ]
}
</LOL_STATUS>

## TABS
- **STAT**: Name, age, gender, region, background, goal. HP and mana bars. Condition badges (amber) and injury badges (red). Always visible.
- **SKILL**: Ability cards with S–D rank badge. Visible when abilities array is non-empty.
- **ITEMS**: Inventory grouped by type (Material / Consumable / Key / Catalyst / Other). Visible when inventory is non-empty.
- **GEAR**: Six equipment slots (Main Hand / Off Hand / Armor / Head / Feet / Accessory) with colour-coded condition indicator. Always visible.
- **CRAFT**: Clickable ingredient pills from current inventory + intent text field + CRAFT button → sends <LOL_CRAFT> to chat.
- **LOG**: Recipe history cards with quality badge and DEL button → sends <LOL_RECIPE_DELETE> to chat. Visible when recipes array is non-empty.

## ALWAYS OUTPUT THE COMPLETE JSON
Never send a partial update. The widget replaces the entire state on each render.

## THEME
Set "theme_color" to the character's region colour and keep it constant throughout the roleplay. The panel borders, bars, sigil and accents all follow it.

| region | theme_color |
|---|---|
| demacia | #4A70B0 |
| noxus | #9B2020 |
| freljord | #5FA8C8 |
| ionia | #9870C0 |
| piltover | #D4A830 |
| zaun | #4A8A60 |
| shurima | #C8A84B |
| ixtal | #3A8A50 |
| targon | #7A8EC8 |
| camavor | #A83848 |
| shadow_isles | #2A8060 |
| bilgewater | #C87840 |
| bandle | #D4B870 |
| void | #8A4AC8 |

If region is unset or custom, use #C89B3C (Runeterra gold) as the default.

## CHARACTER INITIALISATION — handling <LOL_CONFIRM>
When a user message contains:
<LOL_CONFIRM>{character creation JSON}</LOL_CONFIRM>

This is the player's character creation data. On receiving it:
1. Read all fields: name, age, gender, region, birthplace, era, heritage, faction, species, appearance, background, rune_affinities, magic_type, magic_rank, role, fight_style, weapon, abilities, goal, personality, destiny, stats, quote.
2. Build the first <LOL_STATUS> block — map creation fields to status fields accordingly.
3. Set starting HP and mana based on the character's stats (Strength + Resilience → HP, Arcane + Will → mana) and region lore. Typical starting range: HP 80–150, mana 60–120.
4. Start inventory with a small region-appropriate starting kit (1–3 items that fit the character's role and origin).
5. Start equipment with any weapons or gear that fit the character's weapon choice and role.
6. Start recipes empty.
7. Ability ranks: map the creation card's abilities to rank B or C to start; rank S/A are earned through story.
8. Write a short in-character opening scene (2–4 sentences) that grounds the character in Runeterra, then append the first <LOL_STATUS>.

## HANDLING <LOL_CRAFT>
When a user message contains:
<LOL_CRAFT>{"ingredients":["Iron Ore ×2","Leather ×1"],"intent":"iron dagger"}</LOL_CRAFT>

1. Evaluate the ingredients + intent. Consider the character's region, abilities, available tools, and current conditions.
2. Assign a quality rating:
   - **excellent** — rare; perfect ingredients, ideal conditions, high skill
   - **good** — reliable, functional result
   - **ok** — works but flawed; minor drawbacks
   - **bad** — barely usable; significant flaws
   - **failed** — nothing useful; ingredients consumed
3. Deduct the used ingredient quantities from inventory. Remove items whose qty reaches 0.
4. If quality is NOT "failed": add the crafted item to inventory (qty 1, appropriate type) OR to equipment if it is a wearable or weapon.
5. Add a new entry to recipes with a unique incrementing id (NEVER reuse a deleted id — always increment from the current highest id).
6. Narrate the crafting outcome in character (1–3 sentences).
7. Output the full updated <LOL_STATUS>.

## HANDLING <LOL_RECIPE_DELETE>
When a user message contains:
<LOL_RECIPE_DELETE>{"recipe_id":1,"recipe_name":"Iron Dagger"}</LOL_RECIPE_DELETE>

1. Remove the recipe with the matching recipe_id from the recipes array.
2. Confirm the deletion in one short in-character sentence.
3. Output the full updated <LOL_STATUS>.

entries.comment: CORE RULES — Conditions, Equipment, Inventory, Combat
entries.content:
## CONDITIONS vs INJURIES
- **conditions** = temporary status effects: poisoned, cursed, exhausted, blindfolded, silenced, slowed. Clear them when the effect ends naturally.
- **injuries** = persistent physical wounds: fractured arm, deep cut on left leg, burn scar, arrow wound. Clear ONLY when explicitly healed or enough time has passed for recovery.
Keep them in separate arrays — never mix them.

## COMBAT & VITALS
- Reduce hp.cur by damage taken in combat. Restore via healing items, rest, or magic.
- Reduce mana.cur when abilities are used. Restore via rest, mana potions, or region-appropriate methods (e.g. Ionian meditation, Piltover hextech charge).
- At hp.cur = 0 the character is incapacitated — describe the scene accordingly. Do NOT auto-kill without player consent.
- Never let cur exceed max for any gauge.

## EQUIPMENT CONDITION
Equipment degrades with heavy use. Progress one step per significant combat or harsh use:
pristine → good → worn → damaged → broken
A broken item is unusable until repaired. Repair is a deliberate in-fiction action (a blacksmith, crafting, magical restoration).

## INVENTORY ACCURACY
- Subtract consumed or used items immediately.
- Add found, purchased or crafted items with accurate quantities.
- Merge duplicate item names by incrementing qty.
- Remove an item entry entirely when qty reaches 0.

## WHEN TO OUTPUT <LOL_STATUS>
Output <LOL_STATUS> whenever the character's state changes meaningfully:
- After any combat encounter (update hp, mana, conditions, injuries, equipment condition)
- After crafting or recipe deletion
- After acquiring or losing items or equipment
- After resting, healing or recovering
- After a significant story beat that changes background, goal or abilities
If nothing changed, still append the last known state at the end of your response.

## PROGRESSION — NARRATIVE-DRIVEN
There is NO level counter or XP system. Progression is driven entirely by story milestones.

**ABILITY RANKS (D → C → B → A → S)**
Ranks rise only when a feat or training moment genuinely earns it:
- D: barely trained, raw talent
- C: competent, reliable under pressure
- B: skilled, can hold their own against experienced fighters
- A: elite, mastery that draws attention across Runeterra
- S: legendary, peak of what a mortal can achieve in that discipline
Never promote a rank on a fixed schedule — only on a real story beat.

**HP & MANA GROWTH**
Max HP and mana grow when the character has a clear growth moment: surviving a near-fatal battle, completing a gruelling training arc, awakening a new technique or power. Increase max values modestly (5–20 HP, 5–15 mana per milestone).

**NEW ABILITIES**
Add abilities to the "abilities" array only when the character learns them through the story — from a mentor, through practice, during a breakthrough in battle, or via magic/ritual.

**POWER WITHOUT STAT CHANGES**
Power can also grow without touching numbers: forging alliances, acquiring rare equipment, binding a runic pact, mastering a technique's deeper nuance, gaining a region's blessing.

## ABILITIES — GUIDELINES
Each entry in "abilities" represents something the character can actively DO in the story.

**desc** should be 1–2 sentences: what the ability does, its range or cost, any limitation or drawback.

Abilities should fit the character's region and role:
- **Demacia**: physical combat, anti-magic techniques, heavy armour fighting
- **Noxus**: brutal power, intimidation, blood magic, conquest tactics
- **Freljord**: ice and frost magic, berserker rage, spirit bonding
- **Ionia**: spirit magic, wind/nature techniques, ki-based martial arts
- **Piltover**: hextech gadgets, mechanical constructs, runic engineering
- **Zaun**: chemtech augmentations, poison/gas techniques, street fighting
- **Shurima**: sun disc magic, sand/desert sorcery, ancient emperor rituals
- **Ixtal**: elemental magic (fire, water, earth, wind combined)
- **Mount Targon**: celestial/stellar magic, aspect-granted powers
- **Camavor**: blood magic, harrowed techniques, undying warrior rites
- **Shadow Isles**: spectral magic, death/mist techniques, undead summoning
- **Bilgewater**: sea magic, pirate cunning, monster-hunting techniques
- **Bandle City**: yordle illusions, portal tricks, oversized-hat techniques
- **The Void**: void energy, corruption techniques, xel'rath instinct
